verses.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.sm: Aperaamo i le faatuatua O lenei, pe se a sa tatou upu i mea na maua i la le tino e lo tatou tamā o Aperaamo?

verses.en: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
verses.sm: Aua ana ta‘uamiotonuina Aperaamo i galuega, po ua ia te ia se mea e mitamita ai; a ua leai i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.sm: Aua se a ea ua fai mai ai le Tusi? Na faatuatua Aperaamo i le Atua, ona taʻua at lea ia te ia e fai ma amiotonu.

verses.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.sm: A o le totogi o le faigaluega, e le taʻua lea o le alofa tunoa, a o le taui lava.

verses.en: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.sm: A o le ua le galue, a e faatuatua i le na te ta‘uamiotontiina le ua faalemata‘u, ua ta‘ua lona faatuatua o le amiotonu.

verses.en: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.sm: Faapei ona faaamuia foi e Tavita o le tagata ua taʻua i ai e le Atua le amiotonu, e le o i ai galuega,

verses.en: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.sm: Amuia e ua faamagaloina o latcu solitulafono, ma ua ufitia a latou agasala.

verses.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.sm: Amuia le tagata e le ta‘usalaina o ia e le Ali.

verses.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.sm: O lenei, pe gata ea i le ua peritomeina ler.ei faaamuia? E le 00 foi ea i le va le peritomeina? Auā ua faapea i tatou, Ua taʻua le faatuatua o Aperaamo o le amiotonu.

verses.en: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.sm: Pe na taʻua ina ua a? Ina ua peritomeina ea o ia, pe Jei peritomeina? E lei taʻua ina ua peritomeina, a ua taʻua ina ua le peritomeina.

verses.en: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.sm: Ua na maua foi le faailoga o le peritome, o le faamaoni mai lea o le amiotonu i le faatuatua a o lei peritomeina o ia; ina ia avea o ia ma tamā o e faatuatua uma lava o e le peritomeina; ia ta'uamiotonuina i latou foi;

verses.en: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
verses.sm: ia fai foi ma tamā o e ua peritomeina, e le gata lava i e ua peritomeina, a e peitai o e savavali i tulagāvae o le faatuatua o lo tatou tamā o Aperaamo, a o le. peritomeina o ia.

verses.en: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.sm: Aua e lei folafolaina atu ia Aperaamo, po o lana fanau, e fai mona tofi le lalolagi i le tulafono, a e maua i le amiotonu ua i le faatuatua.

verses.en: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.sm: Auā pe afai ua tofia e ua i le tulafono, ua faaleaogaina ai le faatuatua, ua faaleiua foi le folafolaga.

verses.en: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
verses.sm: Auā o le tulafono e tupu mai ai le toasa; auā pe a leai se tulafono, ua leai sē soli i ai.

verses.en: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.sm: O le mea lea e maua ai i le faatuatua le mea na folafolaina, ina ia maua i le alofa tunoa; ina ia tumau lea i le aiga uma lava, e le tuli i le ua i le tulafono, a eoo i le ua i le faatuatua o Aperaamo, o le tamā o ‘ia o i tatou uma lava,

verses.en: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.sm: pei ona tusia, Ua ou tofia oe e fai ma tamā o nuu e tele, i luma o le Atua, o lea na ia faatuatua i ai, o le faaola ia o e ua oti, ma le na te valaauina mea ua leai, peiseai ua i ai.

verses.en: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.sm: Na ia faatuatua ma le faamoemoe, a ua leai se mea e faamoemoe i ai, ina ia avea o ia ma tama o nuu e tele, pei ona fetalaia mai, E faapea lava lau fanau.

verses.en: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:
verses.sm: E lei vaivai foi lona faatuatua, e lei manatu foi i lona tino ua oti, po ua selau Ona tausaga, ma le manava foi o Sara ua oti;

verses.en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.sm: e lei masalo vale ia ma le le faatuatua 11e mea na folafolaina e le Atua, a ua malosi tele o ia i le faatuatua ua vivii atu i le Atua,

verses.en: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.sm: ua na mautinoa foi, e mafai ia te ia ona faia o le mea na folafolaina e ia.

verses.en: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.sm: O lea foi ua ta'ua ai lona faatuatua O le amiotonu.

verses.en: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.sm: A e lei tusia ona o ia lava, Ua ta‘ua ia te ia;

verses.en: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.sm: peitai ona o i tatou foi, o le a taʻua i ai, o i tatou O e faatuatua i le na faatu mai i lo tatou Alii o lesu nai e ua oti;

verses.en: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.sm: na tuuina mai o ia ona oa tatou agasala, ma toe faatuina mai ina ia ta'uamiotonuina ai i tatou.
